title: The Resurrection of Christ and the Dead

questions.question: Paul reminds them of the gospel he preached, which they received, in which they stand, and by which they are being saved, if they hold fast to the word he preached to them—unless they believed in ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:1-2 (ESV): "Now I would remind you, brothers, of the gospel I preached to you... by which you are being saved, if you hold fast to the word I preached to you—unless you believed in vain."

questions.question: What are the events of the gospel that Paul delivered as of first importance?
options: That Christ died for our sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures
That Jesus was born of a virgin, lived a sinless life, and ascended to heaven
That God so loved the world that he gave his only Son
That the Kingdom of God is at hand and we must repent
questions.correctAnswer: That Christ died for our sins, was buried, and was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:3-4 (ESV): "For I delivered to you as of first importance what I also received: that Christ died for our sins in accordance with the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day in accordance with the Scriptures,"

questions.question: After his resurrection, Christ appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve. Then he appeared to more than how many brothers at one time?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:5-6 (ESV): "and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve. Then he appeared to more than five hundred brothers at one time, most of whom are still alive, though some have fallen asleep."

questions.question: Last of all, as to one ____, Christ appeared also to Paul.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:8 (ESV): "Last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me."

questions.question: Paul says he is the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called one, because he ____ the church of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:9 (ESV): "For I am the least of the apostles, unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God."

questions.question: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace toward me was not in vain. On the contrary, I worked harder than any of them, though it was not I, but the ____ that is with me.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:10 (ESV): "On the contrary, I worked harder than any of them, though it was not I, but the grace of God that is with me."

questions.question: Now if Christ is proclaimed as raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no ____?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:12 (ESV): "Now if Christ is proclaimed as raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?"

questions.question: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised. And if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your ____ is in vain.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:13-14 (ESV): "But if there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised. And if Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith is in vain."

questions.question: If in Christ we have hope in this life only, we are of all people most to be ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:19 (ESV): "If in Christ we have hope in this life only, we are of all people most to be pitied."

questions.question: But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead, the ____ of those who have fallen asleep.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:20 (ESV): "But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep."

questions.question: For as by a man came death, by a man has come also the resurrection of the dead. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:21-22 (ESV): "For as by a man came death, by a man has come also the resurrection of the dead. For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ shall all be made alive."

questions.question: Then comes the end, when Christ delivers the kingdom to God the Father after destroying every rule and every authority and power. For he must reign until he has put all his ____ under his feet.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:24-25 (ESV): "Then comes the end, when he delivers the kingdom to God the Father after destroying every rule and every authority and power. For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet."

questions.question: What is the last enemy to be destroyed?
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:26 (ESV): "The last enemy to be destroyed is death."

questions.question: Paul asks, "But someone will ask, 'How are the dead raised? With what kind of body do they come?'" He says, what you sow does not come to life unless it ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:35-36 (ESV): "But someone will ask, 'How are the dead raised? With what kind of body do they come?' You foolish person! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies."

questions.question: It is sown a physical body; it is raised a ____ body.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:44 (ESV): "It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body." (Note: "natural" or "physical" depending on translation; ESV uses natural, but the context points to spiritual as the counterpart).

questions.question: What is the mystery Paul reveals regarding the end? "We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:51 (ESV): "Behold! I tell you a mystery. We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,"

questions.question: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last ____. For the ____ will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we shall be changed. (Same word for both blanks)
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:52 (ESV): "in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised imperishable, and we shall be changed."

questions.question: When the perishable puts on the imperishable, and the mortal puts on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written: "Death is swallowed up in ____."
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:54 (ESV): "When the perishable puts on the imperishable, and the mortal puts on immortality, then shall come to pass the saying that is written: 'Death is swallowed up in victory.'"

questions.question: "O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your ____?"
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:55 (ESV): "'O death, where is your victory? O death, where is your sting?'"

questions.question: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 15:56 (ESV): "The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law."

key_verse_text: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that in the Lord your labor is not in vain.
